items.title: Water Minute · Why "free water tests" aren't really free
items.preview:
Words I like;
Free isn't free when the guy holding the test kit also holds a commission check.
Let me save you a headache. When a company knocks on your door offering a free in-home water test, understand what's happening. Most of those tests are theater. They drop a chemical in your glass, it turns purple or foamy, and suddenly you're staring at "proof" you need to buy something today.
Here's the truth. Real water testing gives you numbers. Hardness in grains per gallon. Iron in parts per million. pH. Chlorine. Nitrates if you're on a well. A drop that changes color tells you almost nothing except that a reaction happened. Any water does that. Even good water does that.
A trustworthy test tells you what's in your water and how much. Then it lets YOU decide, on your own time, with no pressure to sign before the guy leaves your kitchen.
If you already own a Re-Ionator Pro Ultra or an RO Pure PRO QC, this is exactly why you're set. You bought based on real numbers, not a color trick. That was a smart call, and your water proves it every single day.
On a well and unsure what's actually in your water? Reply and I'll send you our free water assessment.
As promised, value in under a minute.
Justin
CEO / ClearWave
